text:
Alex M: Hi — I just got my MBP and trying to enroll in Kandji but the web enroll throws a 403 and the device never appears in the MDM portal. Can someone help?
Sara (IT): welcome! can you paste the exact error page or a screenshot? also which macOS version?
Alex M: macOS 13.6.5 (I think). Error says: "Enrollment blocked (403) — device serial mismatch". Screenshot: https://img.company/scratch/xx.png
Sara (IT): hmm, that usually means ABM/DEP assignment didn't match. did you accept the invite link from your work email before starting the setup?
Alex M: yes I clicked the invite link, then did the Setup Assistant. The company sign-in step completed, then it sat on "Waiting for configuration" and eventually failed.
John D: pinging infra — could be the ABM token refresh we ran earlier today. Sara, did the ABM sync complete?
Sara (IT): token updated ~45m ago. Alex, can you run this and paste output?
Sara (IT): ```sudo profiles renew -type enrollment; sudo /usr/bin/profiles status -type enrollment```
Alex M: ran it, here's the output snippet: 
``
profiles: No enrolled profiles were found.
profiles: enrollment failed: 403: device serial not in assigned devices
```
Alex M: also getting blocked when trying to install Docker — installer says system extension blocked.
Priya (Infra): quick tip — on Ventura+ you still need to allow system extensions in Security & Privacy for some kernel-level drivers. But we should get the MDM sorted first so the profile can push the kext allowlist.
Sara (IT): agree. can you share the device serial (from About This Mac or `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep "Serial"`)? I can check assignment.
Alex M: serial C02X1234LJH1
Sara (IT): thanks, checking... yep, ABM shows device unassigned. it looks like the reseller didn't attach the serial to our ABM order. I'll reassign it now, should be quick.
Kandji Bot: Kandji enrollment token rotate in progress. New token will be active in ~2 minutes.
Sara (IT): once I reassign I will trigger a remote push. you may see "Waiting for configuration" again, then a push. please stay online and connected to corp wifi or VPN.
Alex M: on corp wifi now.
(5 minutes pass)
Sara (IT): OK pushed enrollment profile. try the enroll step again (System Settings -> Profiles -> Enroll) or reboot and let Setup Assistant finish if it's mid-flow.
Alex M: re-ran the profiles command: `profiles status -type enrollment` -> now shows enrolled and Kandji profile present.
Alex M: however installer still blocks Docker due to system extension. it shows: "System Extension Blocked: com.docker.driver.linux"
Priya (Infra): once MDM is in you should receive a settings profile that includes the Team ID allowlist. If it didn't apply, open System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Extensions and look for a prompt to allow. if nothing, reboot.
John D: if you still can't enable, I can create a 30-min temporary admin account to let you complete installs and local dev setup. Sara do you approve?
Sara (IT): fine with temporary sudo for onboarding tasks. John, please create and set expiry. Alex, will you need Homebrew and Docker installed?
Alex M: yes both. thanks.
John D: created temporary admin account alex-temp-admin, expiry in 30m. sent secure note with password via 1Password.
Alex M: got it, sudo works. Installed Docker desktop and Homebrew, allowed the extension by clicking "Allow" under Security & Privacy after the reboot. Docker now starts. :thumbsup:
Sara (IT): checking FileVault status — the MDM should escrow the recovery key automatically on enroll, but let me confirm. Alex, can you run `fdesetup status`?
Alex M: fdesetup status -> "FileVault is On."
Sara (IT): confirmed visible in our console: recovery key escrowed. all good. I've revoked the temporary admin (John please remove) after Alex confirms no more installs needed.
John D: removed alex-temp-admin.
Alex M: confirmed I can still use my normal account and everything works. huge thanks everyone.
Sara (IT): welcome aboard and glad that was smooth(ish). I left a short onboarding checklist in #new-hires pinned message for final items: VPN cert, 2FA app, Slack setup.
Alex M: thanks! one last q — are we expected to enable automatic macOS updates or keep control?
Priya (Infra): we prefer auto-updates for security patches, but dev machines can delay feature updates for a week. I'll DM a short policy doc.
Alex M: perfect, thanks again. :wave:
